meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 你指定版本类型并说发布/部署时,Claude 会自动触发发布流程,等构建通过后核验软件包和发布页,补写发布说明、发公告,并汇报结果。它不会顺手审查或修代码,除非你明确要求。
howto.when: 当你说出“发布”“部署”等关键词,并给出 patch、minor、major 或具体语义化版本号时触发。若只发布没给版本,它会停下问你。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 它会从 1.1.7 升到 1.1.8 并触发发布流程。

say.text: 部署一个 minor 版本
say.note: 新功能向后兼容,版本从 1.1.7 到 1.2.0。

howto.what_en: On a publish request with a version selector, Claude triggers GitHub Actions workflow, waits for success, verifies npm and GitHub release, adds release notes, posts to Discord, and reports. No review or fixes during publish unless asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to publish/release/deploy and give a release selector (patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver). If none is given, it stops and asks.

say_en.note: Bumps 1.1.7 to 1.1.8 and starts the workflow.
Uses that exact version and verifies npm artifacts.
